title: Qiddek gubal yan racmatta
intro: Qur'aanak annal, kaxxa sabri le num, kaxxa sorkocô baxa diggalsimah yan gibbatu kaat boodeh yan. Kullim duugumteh- gaddaay, buxâ maraa kee qaafiyat. uxih niya yirgiqeh, rammitle dooqa kaxxam qammalsime wayta gital gacsen. atu baxxaaqissam duuddaa ta rooci miyyin aydaadi qagisuh qagitaak dabaanitte fan?
clues: Anu kaxxam gibdih tan gibbatut aqayyaare abeeh, kulli dabaanal kassitah.
Anu faxximtam inkih weeh- yi gaddaay, yi xaylo kee yi qaafiyat.
Yi dagar qansaru le daleelit buuleh sugeeh, kulli num yoo waaseh suge.
Niyâ garuq addat, Sheytan gibdaabinaa kee gandit yoo xageh iyyeh Yallah seece.
Yalli yoh gacseeh, ibah baaxo yaatukem yoo amrise.
too aracaak, xabcin raceenaani bakaqteeh, Yalli yi buxah mara gacseh, racmattah namma adda keenih gacse.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Kaxxa dalka kee buxâ maraa kee gadda waanama.
trial.answer: Gibdi biyak kee buxâ maraa kee gadda waanama.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Buxâ mara kee gadda qagitak xibbaaniteh
Baxsime leeh addat amaan le tatur
outcome.answer: Buxâ mara kee gadda qagitak xibbaaniteh

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
